product.name: HEMNES bench
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 4 rails and 4 legs
steps.instruction: Join 4 rails and 4 legs (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the HEMNES bench. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.

The blue parts: A (rail, about 21 cm), B (leg, about 46 cm), C (leg, about 46 cm), D (rail, about 21 cm), E (rail, about 21 cm), F (leg, about 46 cm), G (leg, about 46 cm), H (rail, about 21 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 48 cm tall.

steps.title: Add 2 rails
steps.instruction: Attach 2 rails (I, J) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 5 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
